candidate.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting: AI Reasoning Explored
candidate.description: Explore the world of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting in AI—an advanced technique that boosts LLM reasoning through step-by-step problem-solving. Learn its benefits in accuracy, transparency, and complex tasks, as well as its limitations like high costs and reliance on pattern matching. Discover comparisons with human reasoning and different CoT methods, including zero-shot, automatic, and multimodal approaches.
